title: InstructionLogEntry
description: Append-only, hash-chained evidence of prompt -> intent -> cart -> mandate -> payment. entry_hash = sha-256(JCS(entry minus entry_hash and signature)). Raw content is stored by the operator; only hashes leave it unless an evidence bundle is requested.

stage.description: ai_disclosure is the agent presenting the AI disclosure and the human-handoff routes; it is the first entry whose actor is agent, before intent. handoff is a handoff to a human being requested, accepted or ended. disclosure is the seller's signed quote and disclosures arriving, not the AI disclosure.

actor.description: Who performed the step. assisted_operator, seller_operator and sub_agent name a session participant through actor_ref. Support staff are not log actors: a handoff is logged by the gateway with the accepting operator's key id in actor_ref.

actor_ref.description: participant_id of the acting participant in the session's participants[] (REQUIRED when actor is assisted_operator, seller_operator or sub_agent), or, on a handoff entry, the registry key id of the support operator who accepted it.

content_ref.description: Operator-held encrypted blob (transcript, audio, structured intent)

prev_hash.description: entry_hash of seq-1; genesis uses sha-256 of session_id
